clips.title: The story
paras: Lakeshire's defenders face attacks from orcs, gnolls, and murlocs along Lake Everstill. Magistrate Solomon leads the town, while Marshal Marris commands its guard.

Lakeshire once offered peace in the foothills east of Stormwind. Now it is the kingdom's hardest-pressed frontier. Blackrock clan orcs swept down from the north and overran the garrison at Stonewatch Keep. Dark wizardry stirred Shadowhide gnolls into organized raiding parties. Blackrock saboteurs also broke parts of the Everstill Bridge. Foreman Oslow and his crew struggle to mend the span under threat of attack. Murlocs crowd the lake's shores, while gnolls stalk the high passes. Lakeshire's defenders are close to breaking.
